## bodh-p03-v21 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Who walks by true reflection's power always is freed of all bonds, bliss-full. Fire swallows, well-awake; all-devouring to be known when pure. United by this power, freedom-marked attains purity soon, doubtless. Power grown, universe shines knowing-made; nectar-wave outward. Gone still, form-shown: self plays Lord supreme. Always-knowing frees; freed frees scores instantly. Bliss-powered established; rising-joy-thus bridges onward. Fixed-nature desired even distracted; effort-power attains. Middle opened, bliss-knowing shines; divine vision manifested. Immaculate ranks expand bodiless knowing-vision.

*Rasa: vīra of practiced freedom; raudra of devouring fire; vīra of soon attainment; adbhuta of shining universe; līlā-śānta of still play; karuṇa-vīra of freeing; śānta of standing; vīra of desired-in-distraction; adbhuta of shown vision; adbhuta of bodiless expansion — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: practiced, freed, full. Practice relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierce exultation: swallowed, known. Devouring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: joined, attained, soon. Attainment relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: grown, shining, breaking. Shining relished. The sthāyibhāva is playful peace: still, shown, playing. Play relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-exultation: known, freed, freeing. Freeing relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: powered, standing, bridging. Standing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: fixed, distracted, still desired. Desire relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: opened middle, shown vision. Vision relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: spotless, bodiless, expanding. Expansion relished.*
